prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color material texture for a realistic lunar habitat 3D simulation.
Input image 1: visual style and material authenticity reference only. Generate a NEW flat material swatch, not the photographed scene or any objects from it.
Primary request: Warm neutral very light gray ceramic powder-coated aerospace aluminum alloy. Finest orange-peel grain and tiny microscopic pores, subtle directional handling scuffs and a trace of uniformly distributed lunar dust. Very refined industrial paint, with realistic microscopic texture but clean overall. Plain homogeneous continuous coating without large scratches, no damaged edges.
Style/medium: exceptionally realistic, photographic macro material scan, tangible microstructure, the material authenticity of the reference photograph, absolutely not stylized and not a CGI render.
Composition/framing: 2048 x 2048 square. Orthographic straight-on view, entire image filled by one continuous flat surface. All detail stays in sharp focus. Seamless texture with matching opposite edges, no frame and no border.
Lighting: completely delit base color / albedo scan under perfectly uniform diffuse cross-polarized illumination. No light direction, no specular reflections, no shadows, no ambient occlusion, no vignette or gradient. The actual 3D renderer will supply all lighting.
Constraints: a SINGLE seamless material surface, fine scale texture only. NO screws, rivets, welds, seams, panel lines, raised edges, objects, pipes, hardware, text, logos, lettering, hazard stripes or other large repeating features. No tiles within the image. No sphere or plane preview. No scene. No baked geometry. Opaque surface.
Output: one independent full-bleed square texture image.
qa: Inspected original image. Uniform continuous material scan; no text, hardware, object silhouettes, frames or large baked lighting. Generated tile edges may need blending for mathematically exact tiling.
